actual_file_scope: Entire saved corollary, proof and scope remark read; entire accompanying alternating-automorphism source-verification note read and checked independently.
checks: The source exercise about order-three centralizers is supplied correctly: all relevant alternating centralizers are half the symmetric one, and the factorial equality occurs only for two 3-cycles in degree6. The induction for at least three 3-cycles is strict.

The replacement generated-subgroup test is exact and orientation independent: equal cyclic subgroups have order3; disjoint supports give9; intersection2 gives transitive A4 of order12; intersection1 gives transitive A5 of order60, with orders15 and30 excluded by the written arguments.

Consecutive 3-cycles generate each point stabilizer. Preserved overlap bounds the image support by m-1. Once all point stabilizers are fixed, equivariance of the natural conjugation action proves the automorphism is identity, without relying on the erroneous printed product table or an unwritten base-case induction.

Aut(A_m) has a faithful Fp model of dimension O(log|A_m|); A6 is handled by its faithful action on360 elements, without assuming its exceptional outer structure. The explicit constant64 is sufficient.
The full centreless nonabelian socle has trivial centralizer. Block-permutation Aut(socle) models therefore have dimension O(log|G|) in every characteristic, with no semisimplicity assumption.

Maroti Theorem1.1 is applied with its exact three alternatives. The small-order case gives an actual intrinsic Fp catalogue of dimension O(log²N); the four fixed Mathieu actions are harmless finite cases.

The product-action ambient S_m wreath S_ell has both the faithful subset-product action of degree N and an independent faithful matrix action of rank m ell. For k>=2 and for k=1,ell>=2 the complete written inductions give (m ell)²<=4N. Exactly the natural k=ell=1 action is excluded.

There are at most N³ triples. The intrinsic catalogue logarithm O(log^8N) and matrix cost O(log^4N), together with the product models, obey one uniform B N log(N+1) bound. Actual subgroup actions, rather than only abstract isomorphism types, are represented.

Insertion into the proved hereditary-wreath criterion is valid for actual Hom counts and its unchanged whole-complete-local source scope. It does not identify permutation sets from modular permutation modules or enlarge original-divisorial hereditary scope.
